implementation.baseline_authority: The opaque reviewed candidate retains the verified baseline-pack digest and exact project-snapshot, run-profile, scenario, SDK-coverage, sandbox-posture, and control digests. The run-profile binding is private compiler state so the accepted public policy-proposal/v1 shape is unchanged.
implementation.current_inputs: BindRerun derives an opaque current binding only from a VerifiedPack, exact immutable artifact objects with the five required roles, and the reviewed control bytes. Callers cannot mutate digest fields after construction.
implementation.preflight_order: Start extracts the opaque candidate and compares all seven identities before Backend candidate loading, gateway creation, or project launch. Missing or mismatched inputs return one fixed fail-closed error.

commands.result: The exact-match path passed and every mismatch stopped with zero Backend calls and zero lifecycle-cleanup calls, proving rejection before authority transfer.

limits: This is a deterministic preflight equivalence proof. It does not claim that the later governed project produced matching runtime evidence.
